notice.title: Aria is installed
welcome.title: Welcome to Aria
welcome.intro: A personal assistant that lives on your desktop, works with your files, runs tasks and talks to you in your language. Let's set it up.
welcome.quick.title: Quick setup
welcome.quick.description: Provider, sign-in and your name. Recommended defaults for the rest.
welcome.customize.title: Customize
welcome.customize.description: Models, router, memory, integrations, sandbox, git and subagents.
welcome.later: You can change all of this later.
problem.title: Aria can't start properly
problem.hyprland-classic-config: Aria needs Hyprland 0.56 or newer with the Lua configuration. Yours uses the classic format.
problem.hyprland-not-running: Aria has to run inside a Hyprland session.
problem.hyprland-error: Aria could not talk to Hyprland.
ob.defaults: Use recommended defaults for the rest
ob.provider.title: Choose a provider
ob.provider.desc: Pick where Aria's models come from. You can add more providers later.
ob.quota.title: Quota
ob.quota.desc: OpenCode Go has a quota Aria can read. Decide when to move to the free model.
ob.auth.title: Sign in
ob.auth.desc: Aria stores your credentials in auth.json with permissions 600, so only you can read them.
ob.router.title: Router
ob.router.desc: Jev reads each message and decides how Aria should work on it.
ob.assistant.title: Your assistant
ob.assistant.desc: How Aria addresses you, what it is called and how it talks.
ob.models.title: Models
ob.models.desc: These options come from your provider.
ob.effort.title: Effort
ob.effort.desc: How hard Aria thinks before answering.
ob.compaction.title: Compaction
ob.compaction.desc: When the conversation gets long, Aria compacts the context to save tokens.
ob.memory.title: Memory
ob.memory.desc: Engram lets Aria remember decisions, preferences and solved problems between conversations.
ob.integrations.title: Integrations
ob.integrations.desc: Connect services and add packages. Each service has its own key or sign-in.
ob.sandbox.title: Sandbox
ob.sandbox.desc: Where Aria works, and when it has to ask before going further.
ob.git.title: Git and how Aria works
ob.git.desc: What Aria may do on its own, and what it must ask first.
ob.agents.title: Subagents and Superpowers
ob.agents.desc: Experts that work in parallel, and the skills behind /plan and /execute.
ob.review.title: You're all set
ob.review.desc.quick: Here is what Aria will use. Everything else follows recommended defaults.
ob.review.desc.full: Here is what Aria will use. You can change any of it.
ob.review.desc.edit: These are your current settings. Change any of them.
ob.review.defaultsNote.title: Everything else uses recommended defaults
ob.review.defaultsNote.desc: Router, models, effort, memory, sandbox, git and subagents are set up for you.
ob.provider.opencode-go.desc: A subscription with a quota and free models.
ob.provider.anthropic-api.desc: Your own API key from console.anthropic.com.
ob.provider.anthropic-oauth.desc: Your Claude Pro or Max account.
ob.provider.modules.title: Providers are modules
ob.provider.modules.desc: Each one declares its models, whether it has a quota Aria can read, and which free models it offers. To add a provider later, you only add its module.
ob.quota.switchAt.desc: When the quota reaches this level, Aria moves to the free model.
ob.quota.planSwitchAt.desc: Planning switches earlier, so a plan is never cut halfway.
ob.quota.askFirst.desc: Aria shows a card with a countdown. If you don't answer, the option below applies.
ob.quota.noAsk: Aria switches without asking as soon as the threshold is reached.
ob.signin.stored.title: Stored privately
ob.signin.stored.desc: Credentials go to auth.json with permissions 600, so only your user can read them.
ob.signin.existing: A key is already saved. Paste a new one to replace it, or continue.
ob.error.network-unavailable: Could not reach the service. Check your connection and try again.
ob.error.oauth-timeout: Sign-in took too long. Try again.
ob.error.oauth-state: The sign-in did not match this request. Try again.
ob.error.settings-invalid: The settings could not be saved because the current file is not valid.
ob.router.b1: Route and effort chosen automatically for each message
ob.router.b2: Read-only mode when a message only needs reading
ob.router.b3: Review of the commands the sandbox asks to run
ob.router.b4: Experts assigned to each part of a big task
ob.router.question: Do you want a router?
ob.router.no.desc: Aria handles every message the same way.
ob.router.included.title: Jev is already included
ob.router.included.desc: It comes with this same OpenCode Go account, so there is nothing else to enter.
ob.router.keyDesc: Jev is the router. It runs on TypeSafe, outside your provider. Get a key at console.typesafe.ai/keys.
ob.router.off.title: Turned off without a router
ob.router.off.desc: Automatic route and effort, read-only mode, sandbox command review and expert assignment.
ob.assistant.userName.desc: Aria uses it to greet you and in its replies.
ob.assistant.name: Assistant name
ob.style.brief: Brief, with lists when they help
ob.models.payPerUse.desc: Models billed per request, outside your subscription. Off by default.
ob.effort.label: Effort
ob.effort.note.auto: Jev picks the effort for each message.
ob.effort.note.low: Every message uses the lowest effort. Fast and cheap.
ob.effort.note.medium: Every message uses a medium effort.
ob.effort.note.high: Every message uses a high effort. Slower, more careful.
ob.effort.note.max: Every message uses the maximum effort. The slowest and most expensive.
ob.effort.needsRouter.title: Auto needs the router
ob.effort.needsRouter.desc: Without Jev there is no route to read, so choose a fixed level.
ob.effort.maxOnFree: Run free models at their top level
ob.effort.maxOnFree.desc: Free models cost nothing, so thinking harder is free too.
ob.compaction.compactAt.desc: When the context reaches this share of the window, Aria compacts it to save tokens.
ob.compaction.caption: compacts at {n}%
ob.compaction.noteMemory: Before compacting, Aria saves the decisions to memory. A separator in the chat marks the moment.
ob.compaction.noteNoMemory: A separator in the chat marks the moment. Without memory, only the summary is kept.
ob.memory.toggle.desc: Decisions, preferences and solved problems, kept on this computer.
ob.memory.project.desc: Memories are filed under this name, so searches stay scoped.
ob.memory.words: Search matches words, not meaning, until you add embeddings.
ob.memory.off.title: Aria will forget between conversations
ob.memory.off.desc: You can turn memory on later in the settings.
ob.integrations.notion.desc: Read and write your pages and databases.
ob.integrations.auto.title: Installed automatically
ob.integrations.auto.desc: pi-parallel-agents and superpowers are needed by /plan and /execute, so they install without asking.
ob.integrations.auto.none: No package is installed automatically while /plan and /execute are off.
ob.integrations.trust.desc: A package can run code. Off means Aria shows each package's source and asks first.
ob.sandbox.intro: Commands run in a sandbox that writes only inside your projects folder and can't see your credentials.
ob.sandbox.extraWritable: Extra folders Aria can write to
ob.sandbox.askToLeave.desc: When a command needs the network or other folders, Aria asks first.
ob.sandbox.jevReview.desc: Jev explains what the command does before you decide.
ob.git.commit.desc: Aria makes a commit at the end of each task.
ob.git.push.desc: Off means Aria asks before anything leaves your machine.
ob.git.others: Ask before touching changes that aren't Aria's
ob.git.others.desc: If the working tree has changes Aria didn't make, it asks first.
ob.git.proposals: Deliver what wasn't asked for as a proposal
ob.git.proposals.desc: Extra ideas arrive as a suggestion to approve, not as a change.
ob.agents.saveSessions.desc: Lets you open what each expert did, afterwards.
ob.agents.limitTurns.desc: Stops an expert that keeps going without finishing. Off lets it finish.
ob.agents.planExecute.desc: Aria writes a spec and a plan first, then builds task by task.
ob.agents.skills: Skills that run on their own
ob.skill.brainstorming.desc: Explores the idea before the spec.
ob.skill.writing-plans.desc: Turns the spec into phases and tasks.
ob.skill.test-driven-development.desc: Writes the test before the code.
Runs the checks before saying it's done.
ob.val.authOauth: Sign-in with Claude · saved to auth.json (600)
ob.done.title: {name} is set up
ob.done.desc: Press Super A whenever you want to open {name}.
problem.settings.title: There is a problem with your settings file
problem.settings-invalid: Aria found ~/.aria/settings.json but could not use it. It will not overwrite the file: fix or move it, then open Aria again.
problem.settings-unreadable: Aria could not read ~/.aria/settings.json. Check its permissions, then open Aria again.
ob.integrations.notion.hint: Opens your browser, where you choose what Aria can see.
ob.integrations.tavily.keyDesc: Get one at app.tavily.com. It is checked before it is saved.
ob.integrations.needConnect: Connect each service you turn on, or turn it off to continue.
ob.error.mcp-file-broken: Aria could not write ~/.aria/mcp.json or mcp-auth.json.
